positions.name: AsyncRememberContract
positions.frame: what does the ratified async remember contract commit the system to — receipt, dispatch, and how the result reaches the caller?
positions.why: Both expressions read the same ratified design from the same settled, present-tense direction: Wynn narrates the ratification itself and its guarantees (receipt in seconds, cursor-polled watch, no blocking, no lost work), while Xena's assertive restates the identical mechanics as a 'key decision' — dispatch followed by either polling the run or receiving the reaction piggybacked later. Both are calm-positive, technical-register, present/realis performances of one contract description, differing only in who is animating it (ratifying act vs. restating assertion) — a genuine directional co-reference across two expressions, not a lone witnessed statement standing alone.
